sky.prompt: Dark indigo night panorama with a band of stars, a low magenta horizon glow, and a distant neon city skyline streaked in cyan and pink — a synthwave colosseum at midnight.

icon_core_bolt.prompt: glowing cyan hexagonal energy core with an electric pink inner spark, neon rim light on a dark background, game HUD icon

icon_shield_hex.prompt: neon pink hexagonal shield emblem with a cyan inner ring, glowing edges on a dark background, game HUD icon

icon_clock_ring.prompt: retro-futuristic timer ring, cyan glowing circle with pink hands on a dark background, game HUD icon

music_main.prompt: Synthwave / darkwave loop: driving analog bass, arpeggiated saw lead, pulsing pads, gated snare, 112 BPM — nocturnal, tense, with a hook.

sfx_collect.prompt: bright electric chime, quick rising two-note arpeggio with a soft shimmer tail

sfx_hit.prompt: harsh distorted zap with a pitch drop and a shield-crack crunch

sfx_death.prompt: low synth explosion with a long reverb tail and a sub drop

sfx_boost.prompt: rising whoosh with a filter sweep, like a hover drive flaring

sfx_win.prompt: triumphant synth stab with a major arpeggio burst and shimmer

sfx_lose.prompt: descending minor arpeggio power-down ending on a low thud

prop_neon_pillar.prompt: tall hexagonal column of dark gunmetal with glowing cyan edge strips and a magenta light bar on top

prop_holo_pedestal.prompt: short square obsidian pedestal with cyan trim and a floating glowing pink orb hovering above it

splat_neon_pillar.prompt: tall hexagonal column of dark gunmetal with glowing cyan edge strips and a magenta light bar on top

cutscene_intro.prompt: Opening cutscene of the world of "Neon Arena", a top-down synthwave arena shooter / wave survival game. The camera slowly pushes in and glides over the world, revealing the level, then the hero character appears and strikes a confident pose. Synthwave at night: a deep indigo-black sky over a colosseum floor of glowing magenta and cyan grid tiles, everything edged in bloom-heavy neon. stylised 3D video game cinematic, same characters, world and art style as the image, smooth camera, vivid colour. Upbeat adventurous music.

cutscene_win.prompt: Victory cutscene of the world of "Neon Arena", a top-down synthwave arena shooter / wave survival game. The hero celebrates the win, jumping and cheering, confetti and sparkles burst around, warm triumphant light, the camera circles slowly. Synthwave at night: a deep indigo-black sky over a colosseum floor of glowing magenta and cyan grid tiles, everything edged in bloom-heavy neon. stylised 3D video game cinematic, same characters, world and art style as the image, smooth camera, vivid colour. Joyful fanfare.
